why: Issue #957. 56px is the floor for the on-screen driving controls, deliberately larger than the 44px menu floor because these three sit at the screen edge under a thumb. Collapsing it onto the menu number is the most likely way it would be lost -- it reads like a tidy-up. Before this issue nothing asserted it: `hit-sweep.mjs` skips `.hud-touch` by rule and no catalogue state showed the controls, so the token could drop with every required check green.
killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole keeps the driving controls on their own 56px floor, separate from the menu one
